name: pl.klockoradar/mcp
title: KlockoRadar
description: LEGO set facts, minifigures and current prices in Polish stores, with links to klockoradar.pl.

tools.name: search_sets
tools.description: Find LEGO sets by set number, name or keywords (Polish or English), theme, budget in PLN, age marking, number of pieces, number of minifigures, minifigures or elements found in no other set, and release year. Can sort by price, price per piece, pieces, minifigures, exclusive minifigures or elements, or release date. Returns up to 10 sets with the lowest current amount to pay in Polish stores. Does not cover other toy brands or stores outside Poland.

query.description: Set number, name or keywords in Polish or English, e.g. '75192', 'sokół millennium', 'ferrari'

max_price_pln.description: Highest amount to pay in PLN

max_age_marking.description: Only sets whose age marking on the box is at most this, e.g. 8 for sets marked 4+ to 8+

min_minifigures.description: At least this many minifigures in the box

min_exclusive_minifigures.description: At least this many minifigures found in no other set in the KlockoRadar catalogue so far

min_exclusive_elements.description: At least this many different elements found in no other set in the KlockoRadar catalogue so far

only_available.description: Only sets with a new offer in Polish stores now. Default true with max_price_pln or a price sort, otherwise false

sort.description: price and price_per_piece from the lowest; pieces, minifigures, exclusive_minifigures and exclusive_elements from the highest; newest by release date

tools.name: get_set_prices
tools.description: Current prices of one LEGO set in Polish stores: up to 5 cheapest stores with the amount to pay, delivery and check time, the number of stores that have it, and the lowest and typical product price of the last 30 days. New sets only, PLN, Amazon not included.

language.description: Language of the conversation, pl or en; the card is shown in it

tools.name: get_set_details
tools.description: Facts about one LEGO set: pieces, minifigures with names, which minifigures and elements are found in no other set, price per piece, release date, retirement, where LEGO sells it, age marking and box size, plus the lowest current amount to pay in Polish stores.

language.description: Language of the conversation, pl or en; the card is shown in it

tools.name: find_minifigures
tools.description: Find LEGO minifigures by character name and see which sets contain them: whether the exact minifigure is found in one set only, in how many sets it appears, and up to 3 sets with the lowest current amount to pay in Polish stores. Names are in English. Minifigure values are not included; known ones are on the set page.

query.description: Minifigure or character name in English, e.g. 'Darth Vader', 'Hermione', 'Iron Man'

tools.name: get_price_history
tools.description: Price history of one LEGO set in Polish stores: lowest daily product price, delivery not included, over the last 30, 90 or 180 days (up to 26 points, data from 2026-08-29), the lowest and the highest of these daily prices, and today's lowest product price. Amazon not included.

days.description: History window in days, rounded up to 30, 90 or 180; default 90

tools.name: find_deals
tools.description: LEGO sets whose current amount to pay in Polish stores is low compared with their own price history and the LEGO catalogue price. Optional theme and price range. Returns up to 8 sets, Amazon not included.

language.description: Language of the conversation, pl or en; the card is shown in it

min_price_pln.description: Lowest amount to pay in PLN

max_price_pln.description: Highest amount to pay in PLN
